description: Ask Verdict to rate an entity it does not rate yet, and get a reference id back. Requesting a rating never buys a grade or moves one: ratings stay independent, and the resulting rating is public either way, readable by anyone through these tools. The team replies to the email address you pass, so ask the user for a real one first. Example: request_new_rating({ entity_name: 'Morpho Blue', entity_type: 'protocol', contact_email: 'team@example.com' }).

contact_email.description: Email the Verdict team replies to. Ask the user for it; never invent one.

entity_name.description: The entity to rate, as it is publicly known, e.g. 'Morpho Blue'.

entity_type.description: What kind of entity it is: protocol, chain, token, oracle, vault, organisation, or bridge.

note.description: Optional context: links, chains it is live on, why it matters, any deadline.

name: request_new_rating
title: Request a new Verdict rating
